name: Ops
block_reason: The walk's account set carries member accounts only (t1/t2); this lens sits in the walker's admin_lenses config, so the run performs the look-only gate check and stops: every phase NOT_RUN and every replay ticket skipped 'admin lens without an admin session (look-only gate check only)'. The page itself loads for the member account (HTTP 200, reach gate 'admin', reason 'gate did not hold') — the platform's admin gate not holding is the run's HIGH finding on this lens, and it is also why no substantive walk exists: there is no admin session to walk with.
unblock: Seat the admin account in the walk's account set (the LC-02 accounts leg: zukoqadmin) so walk 2 runs this lens with an admin session.
Run the UPGRADE-PLAN U6 look-only protocol for the admin set: with the admin session the surface phases execute; the member account's 403/no-access words count as PASS once the platform gate holds.
The gate-did-not-hold HIGH finding is the platform fix's own ticket (named in this profile's nov17_run.high_findings); the walk re-checks the gate first on the post-fix build.
walk2_disposition: Walk with the admin session under the look-only protocol; gate re-check first.
